 My 10 Definitions of an Actuary

# 1) A clear communicator who puts decision-makers in the best position to succeed.

# 2) Someone who explains complicated math, statistics, and finance to various audiences.

# 3) Risk expert.

# 4) An Actuary models uncertainty, but does not predict it.

# 5) Actuaries are stakeholders in the Government.

# 6) Actuaries manage large, complicated financial risks.

# 7) Actuaries identify risks, then quantify them, then make decisions, and finally communicate about it in documentation.

# 8) An Actuary is accreditted after completing a series of rigorous exams that require math, stat, finance, and predictive analytics.

# 9) Life Actuaries have expertise in pension, life and health policies. Property/Casualty Actuaries handle general insurance, auto, P/C claims.

# 10) Actuaries use Professionalism and work from an Actuarial Framework to solve problems: Define, Solve, Monitor Results. Iterative and repeatable.
